near_duplicates.resolution: unresolved: the kid page says Meitav has "מסלול נוסף – עוקב S&P 500" in child savings, but the regulator's 2026-09 list and Meitav's reports page show only four child-savings tracks; the halacha track's equity exposure tracks the S&P 500 since 1.11.2024, which may be what the page means; see entry meitav-chisachon-lekol-yeled-okev-sp500

notes: Track of Meitav's child-savings investment provident fund (regulator classification "קופת גמל להשקעה - חסכון לילד"), the kupat gemel lehashkaa side of the National Insurance "חיסכון לכל ילד" programme. cma_fund_id is null: no Meitav document read gives the parent fund number. The reports page adds: "החל מיום 1.11.2024 ונכון למועד הפרסום – נכסי המסלול בחשיפה מנייתית עוקבת אחר מדד s&p500".
